$about: The labs index (labs/index/, PLAN.md WP 10.8) is built from this list. Each entry is a page under labs/ (page: its directory) with links [label, what to add to its address], what it is for and the x command that does the same job without the page. keep: pages and labs worth keeping. temporary: one-off comparisons and experiments, each with the date it was added, the question it answers, its answer once settled, and the date it expires; node x lab list fails on one past its date. node x lab add|rm|list keeps this file; tests/e2e/labs.spec.ts opens every link.

entries.title: The Stress Box
entries.what: The engine's integration target: every capability in a scene of its own, from a room with the hero to crowds, fights, ragdolls and clip mode.
entries.command: node x sim labs/box/scenes/<scene> · node x shot labs/box --scene <scene>

entries.title: The playground
entries.what: The third-person playground: the gym, the house and the town, its five cameras and two looks.
entries.command: node x feel · node x shot labs/playground

entries.title: The starter game
entries.what: The game a new game starts from: rounds, a best score and a bot that plays it.

entries.title: Animation Lab
entries.what: The humanoid on every build and the mannequin in a row, told one state, pose, stance or move from one clock; a move's phases on a timeline to scrub; the bones drawn over them.
entries.command: node x gallery move · node x sheet · node x sim labs/anim/scenes/lineup

entries.title: Materials Lab
entries.what: Every material on its cube and every look over its set of things.
entries.command: node x gallery material · node x gallery look

entries.title: Props Lab
entries.what: Every prop where it stands, turned on the gallery's stage.

entries.title: Effects Lab
entries.what: Every emitter, burst again and again.

entries.title: Cameras Lab
entries.what: One set of things seen through every camera the engine has: the classic views, orbit, fly and fixed, each switched to with its blend.

entries.title: Physics Lab
entries.what: The box's physics scenes with their settings at hand: ragdolls falling and getting up, and the hall's props by the hundred.
entries.command: node x sim labs/box/scenes/ragdoll · node x inspect

entries.title: Library Lab
entries.what: The clip library: search it, play a clip on the mannequin and the hero, read and edit its text, mirror it, step its frames.
entries.command: node x anim find · node x anim show · node x anim bake
